dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single thick, high-contrast white band visible across the median coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, sharp-edged white margins along the outer webs of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct rectangular-shaped high-contrast white patch on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct non-linear boundary characterized by a dark crown transitioning into a white nape patch before the grayish-brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white auricular/cheek patch visible on the lateral side of the head.
